checks.command:
out=$("${HERMES_HOME:-$HOME/.hermes}/scripts/user-lifespan-check.sh" 2>&1); rc=$?; if [ "$rc" -ne 0 ] || printf '%s' "$out" | grep -Eiq 'fail|error'; then printf 'FAIL lifespan check
'; exit 1; elif [ -n "$out" ]; then printf 'REVIEW_NEEDED lifespan entries
'; else printf 'OK lifespan
'; fi

safe_state.description: Do not prune or alter memory when the lifespan check reports a problem; the result may contain private memory text and must be reviewed by the human.

sampling.what: Daily lifespan-check outcomes and a count of due, unclassified, orphaned, or failed records; do not sample or expose entry text.
sampling.working_well: The check completes and any non-empty or failure result is surfaced as review-needed without changing USER.md or USER.json.

open_decisions: Confirm that the installed wrapper path and the 08:00 schedule are supplied by the external scheduler; the contract interval alone does not encode a clock time.
